title: Replicating CAA on a different concept: 'evaluation awareness' / 'I am being tested'

original_idea.body: Build eval-vs-casual contrast pairs, extract a CAA vector for evaluation-awareness on an open model, and test whether steering it changes the model's propensity to behave well only under perceived evaluation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: eval-awareness steering bears on models gaming safety tests, a core long-horizon scheming concern.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Eval-vs-casual contrast pairs + CAA steering; one GPU.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Scheming/eval-gaming work labs are only starting, open models, foundational long-horizon.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness steering explored (some sources LessWrong); this replication may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: CAA replication for eval-awareness may be partly open (partly in blog posts).
